newsitem.title: USA: SFX to sell radio stations for $60 mln.
newsitem.headline: SFX to sell radio stations for $60 mln.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said on Thursday it had agreed to sell its Jackson and Biloxi, Miss., stations to Capstar Broadcasting Partners for $60 million in cash.
In a second transaction, SFX also said it would swap a Daytona Beach station and two Wichita FM stations in an even exchange for stations WESC-FM, WESC-AM and WFNQ-FM in Greenville, S.C.

"These two transactions are certainly in keeping with our overall strategy of concentrating our resources in larger markets, and whenever possible redeploying our assets where we already operate station clusters", said SFX chairman Robert Sillerman.
Once the transactions are completed, SFX will own and operate or provide services to 72 stations in 20 markets, the company said.
